product_overview: Asgard Production Hub is a textile factory management frontend for monitoring loom operations, logging shift production, calculating worker payouts, tracking weaving skills, and importing batch records. It provides a centralized dashboard for operators, supervisors, managers, and payroll users to access core production workflows.
core_goals: Monitor factory output, active looms, and efficiency at a glance
Log shift production data for workers and looms
Calculate and review piece-rate worker payouts
Track weaver skills, certifications, and worker performance
Import bulk production and attendance data from spreadsheets

features.name: User Login & Session Management
features.description: Users can sign in with an email address or operator code and optionally remember the workstation for future access.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email or operator code -> Enter password -> Optionally toggle workstation persistence -> Submit the login form -> See the main dashboard

features.name: Factory Dashboard Overview
features.description: Users can review high-level factory metrics and move into operational areas from the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View total output, active loom count, average efficiency, and total payout metrics -> Review loom status overview and performance summaries -> Open another factory subsystem from the dashboard navigation

features.name: Production Operations & Floor Monitoring
features.description: Users can monitor loom activity, filter machines by status, and inspect production details for active equipment.
user_flows: Navigate to /production -> Filter looms by operating status -> View loom efficiency charts and output meters -> Select a loom to inspect its details
Navigate to /production -> Review active looms and current production conditions -> Switch between status views such as Active, Idle, and Maintenance -> Observe the updated floor monitoring results

features.name: Production Entry Logging
features.description: Users can submit shift production records for a worker and loom, including output and defect counts.
user_flows: Navigate to /production/entry -> Select a worker and loom -> Enter meters produced -> Enter defect count -> Submit the shift report -> See the recorded production entry
Navigate to /production/entry -> Select a worker and loom -> Enter a negative or otherwise invalid production value -> Attempt to submit the form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Piece-Rate Payout Management
features.description: Users can review payout calculations, filter statements by pay period, and export or approve payout summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to /payouts -> Filter payout statements by pay period -> Review the itemized earnings breakdown -> Export the payout summary
Navigate to /payouts -> Filter payout statements by pay period -> Review worker earnings details -> Trigger the payout approval flow -> See the approval-oriented payout state

features.name: Skill Matrix & Competency Management
features.description: Users can browse weaver skill levels, certifications, and assign workers to specialized loom machinery.
user_flows: Navigate to /skills -> Filter weavers by skill level or certification -> Review the skill matrix -> Assign a weaver to specialized loom machinery
Navigate to /skills -> Review competency levels across weavers -> Compare skills for different machinery types -> Choose an appropriate worker assignment

features.name: Worker Profile & Performance Tracking
features.description: Users can inspect an individual worker’s production history, skill badges, and performance trends.
user_flows: Navigate to /workers/W101 -> View the worker’s historical production graph -> Inspect skill badges and shift performance history -> Review earnings and efficiency trends

features.name: Excel Bulk Import
features.description: Users can upload spreadsheet files, map columns, and import production or attendance records in bulk.
user_flows: Navigate to /excel/import -> Drag and drop or select an Excel/CSV file -> Map spreadsheet columns to database fields -> Start the import -> See the imported record processing results
Navigate to /excel/import -> Upload a spreadsheet -> Review missing or incorrect column mappings -> Correct the mappings before importing -> Start the import

routes.description: Main Dashboard showing production metrics, active loom status, piece-rate summaries, and quick navigation.
Operator and Management Login screen with workstation persistence.
Real-time Loom & Production Floor Operations dashboard.
Daily/Shift production log entry form for weavers and supervisors.
Worker piece-rate payout calculation, approval, and distribution module.
Weaver skill matrix, competency levels, and training tracker.
Worker detail page showing historical efficiency, earnings, and skill breakdown.
Excel batch import interface for bulk attendance and production records.
